card.name: When or in after monitoring advice
card.fires_on: The small words "when" or "in" right after an instruction to monitor, use caution, or reduce dose, just before a patient group or co-given drug is named.

modes.label: when + co-use
modes.description: "when" after a monitoring or dose instruction, introducing co-administration with another drug.
modes.example: Appropriate monitoring should be undertaken<< when>> anticoagulants are prescribed concurrently

modes.label: in + patients
modes.description: "in" after a monitoring or caution phrase, introducing a patient group.
modes.example: Monitor renal function periodically<< in>> patients receiving valsartan and NSAID
